messages:
incident-bot: Pager opened for P1 – control-plane dependency surge. Elevated 5xx and gateway 502s starting ~12:04 UTC. Affected services: auth, org-lookup, config. Impact: partial tenant failures on API calls. Alert INC-2026-3365. @nina (oncall) paged.

nina (oncall): Acked — I'm on it. Spinning up traces and dumping metrics now.

mike (sre): I'm looking at auth -> org-lookup path. Latency to org-lookup pods jumped to ~1.2s and error rate ~7%, gateway returning 502 for some requests. Any recent rollouts?

eng-anna: We had a config change at 11:59 UTC that increased heartbeat fanout (flag: increase_heartbeat_burst=true). I can roll that back if needed.

nina (oncall): Please do the rollback as a priority. Also consider reducing fanout concurrency.

eng-anna: Preparing rollback. Patch to flip feature flag in FF service and rollout revert to 30s.

mike (sre): Observed logs: `upstream timeout after 1100ms` and `connection reset by peer` from org-lookup. Might be connection saturation. Creating DB and socket dashboards.

ops-lucas: Suggest temporary mitigations: reduce heartbeat concurrency, enable cached fallback for org lookups (short TTL), and consider a quick restart of org-lookup pods to clear stuck sockets.

sre-jordan: Pushing cached fallback: proxy will return cached org metadata (TTL 30s) for failures. Feature flag enabled.

eng-anna: Rollback executed: set `increase_heartbeat_burst=false`. Rolling out now.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollback event completed at 12:17 UTC by eng-anna.

nina (oncall): After rollback, 5xx rate dropped from ~7% -> ~1.6%. Still above baseline but improving. Keeping circuit-breaker and cached fallback for safety.

mike (sre): Applied a proxy patch to limit concurrent inflight org-lookup calls per tenant: `max_inflight_per_tenant=50`. Also enabled adaptive rate limit for auth calls.

ops-lucas: Ran `kubectl rollout restart deploy/org-lookup -n controlplane` to clear TIME_WAIT sockets — restart finished.

mike (sre): Post-restart metrics: error rate dipped to ~0.8% at 12:30 UTC, latency tails improving. DB connections earlier spiked; investigating pool misconfiguration.

nina (oncall): Customer impact summary for support: some tenants saw intermittent 502/504 for API calls that perform org lookups. Mitigations applied: rollback of heartbeat flag, cached fallback, reduced concurrency, pod restarts. ETA next update 12:45 UTC. @support-team (bot) please notify CSMs and affected customer channels. :rotating_light:

support-team (bot): CSMs and support queues notified with initial impact blurb.

mike (sre): I'll own follow-up. Creating incident ticket INC-3365 with timeline, commands, diffs, and notes. Early hypothesis: heartbeat fanout caused request amplification -> connection pool exhaustion in org-lookup -> upstream timeouts -> gateway 502s.

eng-anna: Added rollout diff and the rollback diff to the ticket. Propose adding canary gating and max-fanout guardrails for future config changes.

sre-jordan: Post-incident remediation plan (prelim): 1) DB connection pool tuning for org-lookup, 2) add early-fail circuit-breaker on org-lookup, 3) enforce per-deploy fanout/canary limits for heartbeat flags, 4) synthetic canary test that fires heartbeats pre-rollout.

nina (oncall): Closing pager handoff — handing ownership to mike for the 4h postmortem and RCA. Good work team. :handshake:

incident-bot: Pager closed at 12:36 UTC. Severity lowered to P2. Incident ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3365

nina (oncall): Final note — this was a silent degradation (errors crept up due to heartbeat amplification) rather than an obvious full outage. Recommend adding a high-sensitivity alert on small error-rate upticks for critical control-plane deps.

mike (sre): Acknowledged. I'll include tuning and alerting changes in the ticket and schedule a postmortem meeting.

eng-anna: I'll follow up with a PR to add a canary gate to the feature-flag rollout process.

ops-lucas: Leaving logs and exact commands in the incident ticket for the oncall rotation.

nina (oncall): Thanks everyone — handing off.
